signIn.title: Sign in to submit a version.
signIn.body: Each version belongs to an account, and we use GitHub to know which. Sign in and your account exists, with nothing else to fill in.

seasonNotOpen.title: {season} is not taking submissions.
seasonNotOpen.bodyNone: This game has no open season. An administrator schedules each season, and this form starts working on its opening date without anything from you. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).
seasonNotOpen.bodyScheduled: It opens on {date}, and you will use the form below then. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).
seasonNotOpen.bodySettling: Submissions closed on {date}, and the season is settling: runners are playing out the queued matches and we are counting their ratings. The next season opens when an administrator schedules it. Your models are still on [their ladders]({ladders}).

notAParticipant.title: Your account is not on this season's list.
notAParticipant.body: You signed in, but this season is open only to a list of invited accounts, fixed when it opened, and yours is not on it. Your model is fine, and it can enter any season open to everyone.

versionInFlight.title: This model already has a version in flight.
versionInFlight.body: {model} v{version} is {phase}, and each model has one version in admission at a time. Wait for [it to finish]({path}); if admission rejects it, you can submit again at once. Your other models are unaffected.
versionInFlight.bodyUnknown: Each model has one version in admission at a time.

weightsEntered.title: These weights are already entered.
weightsEntered.body: This season accepts each set of weights once, so a model.onnx that is already entered cannot take a second place on the ladder. Train a different model or retrain this one: any change to model.onnx changes its hash.

noModel.title: You have no model in {game} yet.
noModel.body: Each version belongs to a model, and a model starts as a name. [Make one on Your models](/me?new=1), which takes one field and enters nothing, then come back here to submit its first version.

form.modelPrompt: Which of your models is this a version of?
form.idle: This page reads and hashes the file, and uploads it when you submit.
form.hint: Your browser hashes both files and uploads them to the object store without passing through the site, and we re-hash what arrives. See [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting).
form.hintNext: Your browser hashes both files and uploads them to the object store without passing through the site, and we re-hash what arrives. This one would be v{next}. See [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting).

noHash.title: This browser cannot hash the files here.
noHash.body: `crypto.subtle` exists only over https or on localhost, and this page came over neither. Submit through the API instead; [submitting a version](/docs/competing/submitting) has the two calls.

form.reassure: Submitting replaces nothing yet. Your active version keeps playing until the new one passes its trial.

pick.notJson: {name} is not JSON, so it is not a manifest. Pick manifest.json.

checks.title: Admission checks
items: Both hashes match what arrived, byte for byte.
The manifest declares the shapes the graph has, and its adapters run inside the operation budget.
Model and manifest together fit a weight class, and their size picks which.
If the season asks for unique weights, nobody has entered this model.onnx before.

items.name: uploaded
items.said: This page hashes both files and PUTs them to the object store, bypassing the site.

items.name: submitted
items.said: We re-hash what arrived and check the list above.

items.name: admitted
items.said: We measure it, give it a class and queue its trial.

items.name: trial
items.said: One match against a baseline. It passes by finishing under the strike limit, win or lose.

items.name: active
items.said: It replaces this model’s previous version and starts earning a rating on Open and on its class. Your other models keep playing.

classes.title: The weight classes
classes.hint: The measured size picks your class: the graph's bytes plus the manifest's. Admission refuses an entry over the largest cap.
classes.hintSeason: The measured size picks your class: the graph's bytes plus the manifest's. Admission refuses an entry over the largest cap. These are {season}'s caps, and each season sets its own.

uploaded.title: {model} v{version} is in. Both files uploaded.
uploaded.body: Your browser hashed both files and PUT them to the object store, bypassing the site. Admission re-hashes them, measures them into a class and runs the probe, and most verdicts reach the version page within minutes.

uploadFailed.title: {model} v{version} is recorded, but {which} did not upload.
uploadFailed.body: The version exists, but {reason}. **Finish it with the commands below**: both URLs work once, for {expires}, and admission starts the moment the second file lands.
uploadFailed.again: You can also submit again while those URLs are good, and you get fresh ones for the same version with the same expiry. After that, admission gives up on it with `ARTIFACT_MISSING` or `MANIFEST_MISSING`, and your next submission is a new version with a new number.
uploadFailed.finishEnd: from the directory holding the two files
uploadFailed.comment: # the same PUTs the page was making, from a shell
uploadFailed.put: A `PUT` with the file as the whole body, with no headers and no account. Admission refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs from what you declared, and tells you the hash it measured.

refusals.season_not_open: The season closed to submissions after you loaded this page. We recorded nothing.
refusals.not_a_participant: This season is open only to invited accounts, and yours is not on the list. Your model is fine.
refusals.version_in_flight: This model already has a version in admission{inFlight}. Each model has one in admission at a time; your other models are unaffected.
refusals.weights_already_entered: Those weights are already entered, and this season accepts each set once. Any change to model.onnx changes its hash.
refusals.unknown_model: That is not a model of yours. Make one on Your models first; we never create one from a submission, or a typo would start a second lineage with its own version numbers.
refusals.model_retired: That model is retired and takes no new versions. Revive it on Your models, or submit to another one.
refusals.too_many_in_flight: You have as many versions in admission as this season allows at once. Wait for one to reach a verdict.
refusals.too_many_versions: You have entered as many versions as this season allows. The limit is per season, and you start fresh in the next.
refusals.cooling_down: You submitted to this model a moment ago, and this season sets a gap between versions. Try again in a little while.
refusals.hashes_required: Send both hashes, each as sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal characters. Run `shasum -a 256 model.onnx manifest.json` (`sha256sum` on Linux) on the two files you are about to upload.
